intent.rationale: DIV = TAPS - WARMUP is 12 by default and zero if the parameters are overridden to equal values.

labels.note: Divides by TAPS - WARMUP, which is 12 by default but zero when the overridable parameters are equal.
With default TAPS=16 and WARMUP=4 the divisor is 12, not zero.

settlement.note: With the defaults TAPS=16 and WARMUP=4 the divisor DIV is the constant 12; it is zero only under a parameter override, which is not this configuration.
